correctness.rationale: The length lower bound follows from Eulerian circulation augmentation of the no-11 overlap digraph: each deficit state with leading r zeros needs >=r extra edges before a corresponding surplus can be reached; summing gives F_n-1 and explicit zero-appending routes attain it, yielding L=F_(n+2)+F_n-1. For each n=2..6, full cyclic 11-free binary string recursion at this exact L tests all length-n cyclic windows against the full legal target set, then quotients by every rotation and reversal. Independently reconstructed exhaustive results: L=(3,6,10,17,28), labeled=(3,6,20,102,2352), orbits=(1,1,1,3,42); for n=6 every one of 42 orbits has size 56 and every optimum repeats seven of 21 target factors exactly twice. This enumeration is exhaustive only in claimed finite domain.
residual_risks: No all-order enumeration for n>6 asserted; the finite proof is actual exhaustive traversal rather than statistical sampling.
